items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Do you remember roughly in the cemetery where Buddy Fatima, where he was buried? INTERVIEWEE: I think he was buried in the first part of the cemetery...

ctx.x: She says, you go under the big, big gate there. I don't know where they open it. I don't know where. As you walk up, they come in, they get you off, you want a cable on the vault. I don't know what. As far as familiar, that vault, and there was more than that much of a, a lot of a lot of the things that were showing them, my real old vaults, there was a lot of chalk marks and things, brick marks.
Do you remember roughly in the cemetery where Buddy Fatima, where he was buried?
I think he was buried in the first part of the cemetery, in St. Little Street. What was St. Louis Street side? St. Louis Street side, the back of the wall of feet, and that was.
